finalText:
**Big, but mostly mechanical.** 1082 hits across 94 files.

| Must not rename | Why |
|---|---|
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml:13) | public field, breaks clients |
| [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js:8) right side | frozen wire name |
| `migrations/*.sql`, 12 files | applied history, breaks down step |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk`, 4 files | generated, edits get wiped |
| SQL text in `repo/*.js` | real DB column name |

The other 76 files are plain JS names. Safe.

Sign off only if the plan splits code from column. A column rename needs its own migration. The public field needs a new dated API version.
